name: Orrizo Wall Sconce
desc: A contemporary decorative wall sconce featuring a compact black rectangular mounting block, multiple vertical clear glass and brass-tone rods, and a central exposed lamp arrangement. Its layered linear composition creates dramatic upward and downward accent lighting suitable for modern residential, hospitality, and architectural interiors.

specifications.Finish: Black with polished brass / gold-tone accents
specifications.Decorative Elements: Multiple vertical clear glass and brass-tone rods
specifications.Beam Distribution: Upward and downward accent illumination with decorative side glow
specifications.Estimated Dimensions: Approx. 520 mm height x 180 mm width
specifications.Recommended Use: Living room / Hallway / Bedroom / Lobby / Hospitality / Accent wall lighting
